001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.util.Objects;
005
006/**
007 * Wraps an {@link IOException} as an unchecked exception so it can be carried through functional
008 * interfaces, such as {@link com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule#apply}, that do not declare
009 * checked exceptions.
010 *
011 * <p>This type is {@code public} because rule implementations live in other packages and modules
012 * (for example, the database rules in {@code streamconverter-db}) and need to throw it. Its role is
013 * still strictly that of a carrier: it must not escape public command boundaries. Code at a command
014 * boundary (for example, a {@code CommandStageRunner}) must catch this exception, unwrap it via
015 * {@link #getCause()}, and rethrow the underlying {@link IOException} (or a {@link
016 * StreamProcessingException} wrapping it) so that callers continue to observe the checked exception
017 * contract.
018 *
019 * <p>This class follows the same design as {@link java.io.UncheckedIOException}.
020 */
021public final class UncheckedStreamException extends RuntimeException {
022  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
023
024  /**
025   * Constructs a new UncheckedStreamException with the specified cause.
026   *
027   * @param cause the {@link IOException} to wrap
028   * @throws NullPointerException if {@code cause} is {@code null}
029   */
030  public UncheckedStreamException(IOException cause) {
031    super(Objects.requireNonNull(cause));
032  }
033
034  /**
035   * Returns the cause of this exception.
036   *
037   * @return the {@link IOException} that was passed to the constructor
038   */
039  @Override
040  public IOException getCause() {
041    return (IOException) super.getCause();
042  }
043}
